open_points.subject: flow:start_and_recover_kernel / step 3 check_installed_instances
open_points.text: "capability:bindings.check_installed_instances: no credential header has, case-insensitively, the name of a required header of its instance or of a header the kernel sets itself, `host` included (A09 rule 1)."
open_points.question: If this startup check cannot read or parse a selected service manifest record (or cannot obtain required_headers), must kernel startup fail immediately, or may it continue and defer the problem to send/propose time?
options: Fail startup on any manifest-read/parse problem in this check
Continue startup and treat missing required_headers as none
Continue startup but mark service unusable until restart
open_points.default_guess: Fail startup immediately on any manifest-read/parse failure during check_installed_instances.

open_points.subject: flow:run_effect_with_approval / step 6 grant_standing_approval target node kind
open_points.text: "grants a node of the flow's active version ... whose class is not `destructive`"
open_points.question: Can a standing grant be created for a function node (which has no effect class), or are grants valid only for operation nodes?
options: Allow grants for function nodes (never used at send time)
Map function nodes to an implicit class and apply the same rule
open_points.default_guess: Refuse grants for non-operation nodes; only operation nodes are grant-eligible.
